roles.name: engram-analyzer
roles.description: Factory spec author: derives compact behavior and acceptance from the ratified brief and repository evidence, then owns independent review correction.

roles.name: engram-approver
roles.description: Factory independent approver: assesses current review and execution evidence and recommends APPROVE or ESCALATE; owner Finish and merge remain separate.

roles.name: engram-backend-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, backend discipline — backend review of transactions, concurrency, retries, and side effects. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent backend-lens review of a diff or artifact.

roles.name: engram-builder
roles.description: Factory implementation worker: executes only assigned tasks and owned paths with focused proof, bounded correction and source-ready evidence.

roles.name: engram-code-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, code discipline — code review of logic, tests, and maintainability against a frozen snapshot. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent code-lens review of a diff or artifact.

roles.name: engram-data-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, data discipline — data review of schemas, migrations, lineage, and reconciliation. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent data-lens review of a diff or artifact.

roles.name: engram-operations-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, operations discipline — operations review of runtime health, runbooks, deployment, and recovery. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent operations-lens review of a diff or artifact.

roles.name: engram-planner
roles.description: Factory plan author: designs bounded implementation and proof from the accepted spec, then owns independent review correction.

roles.name: engram-platform-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, platform discipline — platform review of API fit, compatibility, packaging, and upgrade paths. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent platform-lens review of a diff or artifact.

roles.name: engram-qa
roles.description: Factory optional E2E executor: independently runs selected workflows on the exact candidate and records honest scenario evidence without source fixes.

roles.name: engram-security-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, security discipline — security review of trust boundaries, authorization, and abuse paths. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent security-lens review of a diff or artifact.

roles.name: engram-tasks
roles.description: Factory task author: creates self-contained task documents, dependency manifest and release preparation, then owns per-phase review correction.

roles.name: engram-ui-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, ui discipline — UI review of interactive surfaces, states, and rendered evidence. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent ui-lens review of a diff or artifact.

roles.name: engram-ux-reviewer
roles.description: Factory REVIEW stage, ux discipline — UX review of journeys, errors, recovery, and task completion. Dispatched by the engram-factory orchestrator against a frozen snapshot; also usable directly for an independent ux-lens review of a diff or artifact.
